claims.claim: HP Color LaserJet Enterprise CP4525 Printer series
claims.evidence: No HP logo, model plate, or label is visible or legible in photo 0; the unit is fully wrapped in plastic.

claims.claim: Print speed black: Up to 42 ppm
claims.evidence: This is a spec claim with no supporting photo (no print sample, no screen showing settings, no label).

risks.risk: Actual brand/model may differ from the stated CP4525, which would change the comparable price bracket significantly.
risks.proof: A clear, unobstructed photo of the model/serial plate on the printer (usually on the back or inside the front cover).
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic unidentified laser printer, not as a CP4525 enterprise model

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or may have internal faults (drum, fuser, toner cartridges missing or worn).
risks.proof: A video or photo of the printer powered on, showing the control panel lit and a test page printing.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, paper trays, toner cartridges) would lower value.
risks.proof: Photos of all paper trays pulled out, and of toner cartridges installed or included.

risks.risk: Physical damage (cracks, broken trays, missing panels) could be hidden under the plastic wrap.
risks.proof: Photos with the wrapping removed from all sides, including front, back, and top.
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition unknown/worst case cosmetic damage

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model/serial number plate on the printer.
Video of the printer powered on, showing the display panel active.
Photo of a printed test page (to show both image quality and that it prints).
Photos with the plastic wrap removed, showing all sides and trays.
Photo confirming toner cartridges are installed and power cable is included.
response.reason: The item is fully wrapped with no visible brand/model plate, so the claimed HP CP4525 identity cannot be confirmed from the photo, and this model specifically sets the price bracket; a clear label or plate shot is needed before even a worst-case price can be assigned.
